test_AIAgent_memory_provider_init: test the AIAgent class initialization with blank memory provider and skip_memory=False to verify no memory manager is created
test_AIAgent_honcho_fallback_disabled: test that a blank memory.provider does not auto-enable the Honcho memory provider fallback during AIAgent init
test_AIAgent_load_memory_provider_not_ca: test that load_memory_provider is not called when memory provider is blank in AIAgent initialization
test_AIAgent_save_config_not_called: test that save_config is not called when memory provider is blank and no auto-enable occurs
test_AIAgent_from_global_config_not_call: test that HonchoClientConfig.from_global_config is not called when memory provider is blank
